rationale: P0/P1 frontend governance requires expanding the shared design-system layer from Button/EcomShell to Button, Card, Input, Badge, and Dialog, plus Storybook coverage and automated gate checks. This prevents page-local styling drift and makes future style changes reviewable through shared primitives.
scope: Shared ecommerce UI primitives, design-system registry, Storybook configuration, a11y lint/static gate, Playwright smoke and screenshot baselines, API contract generation, bundle and Lighthouse budgets.
migration_plan: Keep existing product pages on current shared tokens, register new primitives as active, require new UI increments to consume these primitives, and burn down remaining lint/a11y debt through baseline-reducing follow-up batches.
